name: domotz
description: Network-operations playbooks for MSPs on Domotz: tune noisy alert rules and check that a site is set up the way it should be. Reads your Domotz data, explains what it means, and makes only the reversible changes you approve.

interface.longDescription:
Domotz is a network monitoring platform for managed service providers (MSPs) and IT teams. This plugin adds two network-operations playbooks that work on your own Domotz account through the Domotz MCP server.

Alert tune-up reads a client's alert history and tells you which alerts are noise, which rules need a better threshold and which are real signal, with the counts, devices and dates behind each finding.

Site check-up checks one site after it is installed: devices that would never alert, devices not marked important, missing credentials and configuration backups, and gaps compared with a reference site.

Both end with numbered batches of changes. Nothing changes until you approve a batch, every change is reversible, and the undo is shown before and after.

Intended users: MSP technicians and network administrators with a Domotz account.

Limitations: it acts only within your Domotz permissions and never deletes rules or devices. It cannot change device types, create alert rules or see which notification channel a rule uses; those are listed as actions for you in the Domotz app. It never asks for or handles passwords or other credentials. Large accounts are analysed one client or site at a time. It needs a capable model for the counting the audits require.
defaultPrompt: Run an alert tune-up for my client Acme for the last 14 days.
Run a site check-up on the collector I installed most recently.
